subject.title: [Feature]: Expose Discord slash interaction response controls to plugin commands

question: Should plugin command handlers get a generic command-responder capability, a Discord-specific `ctx.discord.respond` surface, or no new command responder API?
rationale: The requested behavior expands a public plugin SDK and Discord channel contract, and the best permanent shape depends on maintainer direction about generic versus channel-specific plugin APIs.

options.title: Prefer generic responder capability
options.body: Add a typed command responder seam that Discord implements now and other native-command channels can adopt without channel-specific SDK drift.

options.title: Approve Discord-specific responder
options.body: Expose `ctx.discord.respond` for this channel only, accepting a narrower immediate API with more long-term SDK surface risk.

options.title: Decline command responder API
options.body: Keep plugin commands on returned `ReplyPayload` plus `suppressReply`, and document that mixed-visibility Discord flows need a channel/plugin-specific workaround.

recommendation.title: Prefer generic responder capability
recommendation.body: Add a typed command responder seam that Discord implements now and other native-command channels can adopt without channel-specific SDK drift.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent plugin interaction and Discord binding work is closest to the responder-shape decision, though Discord native-command owners should also review.
